verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework driven through its own documented programmatic API: agents take tools through the constructor, and a Mastra server registers agents and workflows and can ship them as standalone endpoints. Agent-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md) are also published. However, the evidence never documents a public HTTP API reference, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at common mastra.ai paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API reference or OpenAPI spec for the server endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Mastra through that API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Add a tool to an agent by importing the tool and passing it to the agent constructor as a tools object.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Mastra docs are the canonical, current reference. Trust them over training data.
